name: Regulatory Compliance & Evidence
description: Regulatory Compliance & Evidence standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-COMPLIANCE applies.

rules.title: Identify applicable regulatory and contractual obligations
rules.detail: For each project, record applicable jurisdictions, regulations, contractual controls and evidence owners before processing regulated data or releasing regulated functionality.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Identify applicable regulatory and contractual obligations.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Identify applicable regulatory and contractual obligations.

rules.title: Map obligations to technical and process controls
rules.detail: Translate each applicable obligation into concrete controls, owners, evidence and review cadence rather than keeping compliance as narrative documentation.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Map obligations to technical and process controls.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Map obligations to technical and process controls.

rules.title: Maintain auditable evidence
rules.detail: Preserve required approvals, configuration evidence, access logs, test results and change records for the defined retention period.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Maintain auditable evidence.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Maintain auditable evidence.

rules.title: Apply least privilege and separation of duties where required
rules.detail: Regulated workflows must identify incompatible duties and enforce independent approval for sensitive actions where applicable.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Apply least privilege and separation of duties where required.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Apply least privilege and separation of duties where required.

rules.title: Review compliance impact when requirements or data flows change
rules.detail: Changes to collected data, integrations, geography, retention or user rights trigger a compliance re-assessment.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Review compliance impact when requirements or data flows change.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Review compliance impact when requirements or data flows change.

rules.title: Document approved exceptions with expiry and compensating controls
rules.detail: Any deviation must state risk, approver, compensating control and review/expiry date.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Document approved exceptions with expiry and compensating controls.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Document approved exceptions with expiry and compensating controls.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-COMPLIANCE applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Regulatory Compliance & Evidence to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Regulatory Compliance & Evidence is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Regulatory Compliance & Evidence failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
